hotel_name: The St. Regis Resort Bora Bora

claims.text: The resort is on a motu, or islet, so boat transfers are needed to and from Bora Bora's airport and the main island.

findings.quote: The St. Regis Bora Bora Resort is located on a motu (islet) and boat transfers will be necessary from/to Bora Bora Domestic Airport or to reach Bora Bora main island (Vaitape).

claims.text: The boat transfer from Bora Bora's airport to the resort takes 20 minutes.

findings.quote: The transfer itself is a 20-minute boat ride.

claims.text: The overwater villas have glass viewing panels cut into the floor, so you can watch tropical fish swim by.

findings.quote: glass viewing panels throughout, cut into the floor to provide glimpses of tropical fish swimming by

claims.text: Every overwater villa has a separate living room and bedroom.

findings.quote: Every overwater villa is comprised of a separate living room and bedroom

claims.text: The Royal Estate is a private compound enclosed on three sides by coral walls, opening onto its own private beach facing the lagoon and Mount Otemanu.

findings.quote: the private compound is enclosed on three sides by coral walls and opens up to its own private beach facing a sparkling lagoon and Mount Otemanu

claims.text: Snorkeling gear for the Lagoonarium is complimentary.

findings.quote: Several pontoons allow easy access for leisurely snorkeling, with complimentary snorkeling gear provided

claims.text: Guests can choose between the Main Pool with a swim-up bar and the Oasis Adults-Only Pool with private cabanas.

findings.quote: Choose between the Main Pool with its lively swim-up bar or the serene Oasis Adults-Only Pool, complete with private cabanas for ultimate relaxation.

claims.text: Te Pahu hosts a Polynesian show and dinner every Wednesday night.

findings.quote: Join us for Polynesian Show & Dinner at Te Pahu every Wednesday night

claims.text: Complimentary watersports at the Main Beach include stand-up paddleboarding, kayaking and local canoe.

findings.quote: Enjoy complimentary watersports at the Main Beach, including stand-up paddleboarding, kayaking and local canoe.

claims.text: A Cultural Ambassador leads activities such as flower crown making and pareo painting.

findings.quote: activities led by our Cultural Ambassador, such as flower crown making, pareo painting, and more.

claims.text: The resort was designed by Parisian architect Pierre Lacombe.

findings.quote: Designed by Parisian architect Pierre Lacombe, the resort made the pages of Architectural Digest when it debuted.

claims.text: Every villa comes with a pair of beach cruiser-style bicycles.

findings.quote: Every villa comes with a pair of beach cruiser-style bicycles with baskets for exploring the sprawling grounds.

claims.text: The resort's overwater villas are the largest in French Polynesia and the South Pacific, starting at 1,550 square feet.

findings.quote: Stay in the largest overwater villas in French Polynesia and the South Pacific, starting at 1,550 square feet

claims.text: The resort's private Lagoonarium is a protected underwater sanctuary for tropical fish and coral, including Napoleon fish.

findings.quote: Our Bora Bora hotel's private Lagoonarium is a protected underwater sanctuary for myriad species of tropical fish and coral, including the remarkable Napoleon fish.

claims.text: The spa sits on its own private island overlooking the Lagoonarium.

findings.quote: Relax and rejuvenate at the spa, located on its own private island overlooking the serene Lagoonarium.

claims.text: Lagoon Restaurant is suspended over the water, with views of Mount Otemanu, and showcases local produce and freshly caught seafood.

findings.quote: This suspended water restaurant in Bora Bora offers views of Mount Otemanu and showcases local produce and freshly caught seafood.

claims.text: Breakfast can be delivered to your villa on a va'a, a traditional Polynesian canoe.

findings.quote: Wake up in the local culture with a delightful breakfast delivered on a va’a, the traditional Polynesian pirogue, to your private villa.

claims.text: The complimentary shuttle to the main island and Vaitape runs once a day and not on Sundays or public holidays.

findings.quote: The Resort extends a once-a-day complimentary shuttle service to the main island and the village of Vaitape, except on Sundays and public holidays.

claims.text: All spa bookings require a day pass.

findings.quote: Please note that all spa bookings require a day pass.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes that the remote French Polynesian location requires extensive travel time.
